collate_atomic_data_list: batch a list of AtomicData objects into a single batch using atomicdata_list_to_batch
collate_with_neighbor_counts: collate AtomicData objects and compute neighbor counts from edge_index for each data sample
collate_to_dict: collate a list of AtomicData objects and return the batch as a dictionary of tensors
collate_with_otf_graph: collate AtomicData objects with otf_graph enabled to skip neighbor count computation
review_data_list_collater: review the data_list_collater function to understand how AtomicData batching and neighbor extraction work
